tasks.title: Pin the Nix and Shen toolchain
acceptance: The root flake pins Python 3.12, uv, Go, Git, jq, hyperfine, and a clean shen-go revision.
The existing capability tests and a Shen smoke test run through nix develop.
Exact revisions and observed results are recorded in EXPERIMENT-PLAN.md.

gates.name: regression
command: cd packages/capabilities && PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .

gates.name: shen-smoke
command: set -eu; output=$(shen eval -e '(+ 20 22)'); test "$output" = 42; ! shen eval -e '(+ 1' >/dev/null 2>&1

acceptance: All fourteen required cases are represented and clearly label synthetic histories and seeded faults.
Expected verdicts, operational states, required and forbidden leaves, discrepancies, and missing premises are reviewable without an evaluator.
Corpus schema tests pass.

Interpreter and residual agree on verdicts, explanations, discrepancies, and normalized certificates.
